name: Dura-Ace conventional-pitch track rear hub
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 313 g for the complete rear HB-7520 solid-axle, nut-fastened track hub including the lockring. The manufacturer drawing confirms a solid axle and hub nuts, with no quick-release skewer. The weighed spoke-hole count and 110/120 mm rear spacing is not identified; no nut or axle mass is subtracted.
